text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonia to give Bulgaria food aid, unofficial diplomatic sources say, and both countries to increase economic cooperation after meeting between Bulgarian interim Prime Minister Stefan Sofijanski and Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski. The language problem was not discussed.
- Largest opposition party blames government for having indolent attitude towards nationalistic Albanian provocations in Tetovo after victory of PDPA at local elections on Sunday.
- Albanian students at pedagogical faculty in Skopje say demonstrations by Macedonian students offend their dignity and are causing inter-ethnic tensions.
